title: Operating diagnostics
description: Diagnostics over the authoritative operating timeline: current state, transitions, unattributed operation, data quality and timeline verification.

unattributed.title: Unattributed operation
unattributed.noData: No operating data has ever been recorded for this resource — durations are unavailable, not zero.

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.clean: No data-quality issues found in the scanned window.
dataQuality.trackingConfigured: Operating tracking is configured for this resource.
dataQuality.trackingMissing: No operating/idle flow nodes are configured — the timeline stays empty until tracking is set up.

kinds.stale-signal: Tracking configured but no signal recently
kinds.negative-duration: Intervals whose end is not after their start

verification.title: Timeline verification
verification.description: Recomputes derived operating durations from the authoritative interval rows and compares them.
verification.noAggregates: No persisted aggregates exist; derived views are verified directly against the timeline.

checks.attributions-within-operating-duration: Attributed duration does not exceed operating duration
